patch_description: Replace independent per-destination shortest paths with a cost-aware multicast-tree heuristic. The new search builds candidate shared delivery trees: the union of independent shortest paths and several greedy directed Steiner-style trees seeded by each destination. It selects the tree with the lowest unique edge cost, then derives source-to-destination paths from that shared tree for every partition. This preserves parallel partition delivery while allowing common trunk links to be transferred once and forwarded to multiple destinations, substantially reducing redundant inter-cloud transfer charges.
